Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] granting transfer rights.
Private mapping counting sales per address, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private sale count limit set by init and enforced in condition.
Private minimum sale amount set by init, derived from unchecked multiplication.
Private maximum sale amount set by init, derived from unchecked multiplication.
Private owner address gating init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Private mapping of addresses whitelisted to bypass the sale condition.
Private address whitelisted in ensure and settable only by owner.
Public total token supply assigned in the constructor.
Public token name string set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string set in the constructor.
Public constant decimals value used to scale amounts in init and constructor.
Constant Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom performing whitelist check, allowance update and unchecked balance arithmetic.
Internal view whitelist gate that returns true for owner, UNI, pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses, otherwise calls condition.
Internal view sale limit check against _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall target.
Owner-only initializer setting _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale with unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only batch balance distribution using unchecked total and loop arithmetic.
Owner-only setter of the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation from factory and token pair.
Payable constructor minting total supply to msg.sender and setting owner.
External caller-controlled address used for ownership, allowance and transfer checks.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address, executing foreign code in this contract storage context.

Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend.
Unchecked multiplication token*(10**decimals) and maxToken*(10**decimals) in init.

edges.reason: msg.sender must equal owner to reach delegate, so the owner-only check gates an arbitrary delegatecall capability.
delegate performs a delegatecall to the caller-supplied address a, executing foreign code inside this contract context.
The delegatecalled code runs with this contract storage and can re-enter or arbitrarily rewrite balanceOf.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as the _from argument.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) to pass before balances are moved.
ensure falls back to condition() for senders not covered by the whitelist branch.
transferFrom subtracts _value from balanceOf[_from] with raw unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom adds _value to balanceOf[_to] with raw unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] when the caller is not _from.
msg.sender determines whether the allowance branch is taken in transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
approve keys the allowance mapping on msg.sender.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length and deducts it with unchecked arithmetic.
batchSend credits balanceOf entries through the unchecked distribution arithmetic.
batchSend is restricted to the owner via require(msg.sender == owner).
init scales token and maxToken by 10**decimals without SafeMath.
_maxSale is written from the unchecked maxToken multiplication result.
_minSale is written from the unchecked token multiplication result.
init requires msg.sender == owner before mutating sale configuration.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before writing the trade whitelist address.
The constructor sets owner and the entire initial balance to msg.sender.
ensure whitelists any transfer where _from or _to equals owner.
ensure whitelists transfers from addresses flagged in canSale.
ensure whitelists transfers from the configured tradeAddress.
ensure whitelists transfers whose _from equals the UNI router constant.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the _saleNum limit.
condition compares the global _saleNum configuration.
condition enforces the _minSale lower bound on _value.
condition enforces the _maxSale upper bound on _value.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after moving balances.
setTradeAddress overwrites the tradeAddress state variable.
Parameter _to flows into transfer and onward to transferFrom.
Parameter _value flows into transfer and onward to transferFrom.
Parameter _from indexes balanceOf and allowance in transferFrom.
Parameter _to receives the transferred amount in transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the amount moved and checked in transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the operand of the unchecked balanceOf subtraction.
Parameter _from is tested against owner, UNI, pair, tradeAddress and canSale in ensure.
Parameter _to is tested against owner in ensure.
Parameter _value is forwarded from ensure to condition.
Parameter _from indexes _onSaleNum inside condition.
Parameter _value is compared with _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
Parameter _spender keys the allowance mapping in approve.
Parameter _value is stored as the allowance amount in approve.
Parameter a is the arbitrary address targeted by delegatecall in delegate.
Parameter b is the calldata payload supplied to delegatecall in delegate.
Parameter saleNum is assigned to the _saleNum state variable in init.
Parameter token is scaled by 10**decimals inside unchecked arithmetic in init.
Parameter maxToken is used to derive the _maxSale bound in init.
Parameter _tos length multiplies _value in the unchecked batch total.
Parameter _value multiplies in the unchecked batch total of batchSend.
Parameter addr becomes the new tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Local _UNI pair address participates in the ensure whitelist comparison.
Local total is derived from the unchecked multiplication and deducted in batchSend.
Local loop counter i drives the batchSend distribution loop.
Local loop variable _to receives each batch credit in batchSend.
Local pair is the computed Uniswap pair address returned by pairFor.
Local token0 is the sorted lower token address hashed in pairFor.
Local token1 is the sorted higher token address hashed in pairFor.
